action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated with moderate seasonality and high predictability. Model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.01) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.881, only 3 independent groups), so fitted weights or larger pools would chase noise. A trimmed mean over the 5 most consistently-ranked models is the robust choice: it discards the worst outlier in each window while retaining the signal from the stable core. The leader is a seeded baseline and the runner-up is statistically indistinguishable (margin 0.004), confirming that no alternative combination kind offers a meaningful edge on this series.
